archetypes.name: dyn-complexity-ratchet
archetypes.rationale: The new audit parser is the enforcement backstop for grandfathered modules.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/lint_complexity_baseline.py and its tests for identity stability, metric parsing, duplicate handling, and exit-code semantics. Pay special attention to AST resolution for nested functions and class methods, absolute ruff filenames, and exempt test harness paths. Verify that failures are actionable without mutating the baseline. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-ruff-config
archetypes.rationale: The generated ruff config and baseline must stay aligned or CI will either miss debt growth or fail on the existing tree.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/ruff.toml, python/ruff-complexity-audit.toml, and python/complexity-baseline.json together. Confirm the audit config excludes only tests and harness modules, production per-file ignores are per-module and code-specific, and baseline rows match the audit parser's normalized key model. Check that Makefile wiring runs the audit from the repo root between ruff and pylint. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
